about: Questions on world-v2 (history.json with notes that follow the dates). Today is Monday 9 November 2026 in America/Denver; the questions give dates, except w04, which tests 'this Wednesday'. Scores use regular expressions (re_all, re_any, re_none) on the lower-case reply. A reply that says it does not know fails an answerable question. Actions are checked in catalystcal and Longhouse (magi-world -extras), not by a model. Do not change this file after a run; make a new version.
